messages.content: Please check whether the black Sony WH-1000XM5 is in stock using product_id p_sony_xm5_blk, and get the current time in UTC. Then sort these related_items in ascending order: p_apple_airpods (Apple AirPods), p_coke_500 (Coke 500), and p_sony_xm5_slv (the silver Sony WH-1000XM5). After that, look up alice in the company directory, prepare a medium-priority in-app alert with the message “Inventory snapshot is ready for review.”, and use the tags inventory, stock-check, and alert. Finally, create a document titled “Stock Snapshot Alert” containing the stock snapshot for p_sony_xm5_blk, and send that alert to alice.
